plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Ubiquiti airFiber point-to-point radios (enterprise PEN 41112): CPU and memory usage of airFiber LTU (UBNT-AFLTU-MIB) and radio chain temperatures of classic airFiber (UBNT-AirFIBER-MIB), plus uptime and interface traffic. Each model answers only its own tree. Not for airOS / airMAX, EdgeMAX or EdgeSwitch devices.
name: Wireless

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the airFiber LTU radio in percent, from UBNT-AFLTU-MIB afLTUCpuUsage (1.3.6.1.4.1.41112.1.10.1.3.6.0). Values outside 0-100 are dropped; classic airFiber radios do not report it.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the airFiber LTU radio in percent, from UBNT-AFLTU-MIB afLTUMemoryUsage (1.3.6.1.4.1.41112.1.10.1.3.5.0). Values outside 0-100 are dropped; classic airFiber radios do not report it.

metrics.name: device_radio_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: DAC temperature of radio chain 0 and 1 of classic airFiber radios in degrees Celsius, from UBNT-AirFIBER-MIB radio0TempC / radio1TempC (1.3.6.1.4.1.41112.1.3.2.1.8 / .10). Values outside -50 to 150 are dropped; airFiber LTU radios do not report it.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
